title: Adopted repositories get a task-scoped standards packet at session start and the Stop hook teaches the violated record
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 8: src/hook/session.ts injects nothing; Stop blocks without teaching or logging.
Outcome: SessionStart/first prompt in an adopted repo injects <=400 tokens of matching records; Stop on a violation prints record id and why and logs the outcome to exposures.
Proof: hook tests on captured Claude payloads (KRN-12).
